items.title: Preserve bootstrap diagnostics and bounded concurrency compatibility
items.context: Cover stable startup, a builder already holding the lock, real missing dist remaining fail-closed, and a dependency-missing fresh checkout retaining actionable bootstrap diagnostics. The temporary candidate imports proper-lockfile too early and must not be copied blindly. Qualify lock release/error handling and relevant platform behavior for the chosen bounded repair. Maintain the user triage rule: current applicable critical/high and acceptance/REVIEW/TEST/DONE or misleading-gate blockers require repair; unrelated nonblocking medium/low defects need traceable reproduction, impact and follow-up owner, with immediate reclassification if evidence escalates. No scope expansion merely to make all repository tests green.
items.userSees: Normal startup still works, genuinely unbuilt checkouts still fail with useful instructions, and the repair does not introduce dependency-loading errors or unbounded waits.
